title: Old Font
description: This resource pack replaces the newer Minecraft font to the original one. I don't know when or why they changed it, but if you liked the older one, here it is!
body:
_This resource pack replaces the newer Minecraft font to the original one. I don't know when or why they changed it, but if you liked the older one, here it is!_

**This only works for the default ascii characters, any others or alternate languages are unaffected by this pack.**

Oh yeah and please ignore the incompatibility warning lol.
